title: Denmark – Transport services (excl. Waste transport) – Transport af hjælpemidler
description: Dette genudbud vedrører udførelse af transport af hjælpemidler, eksempelvis kørestole, rollatorer, el-senge, personlifte m.m. for Hjælpemiddelcentret i Frederiksberg Kommune. Transporten sker mellem Frederiksberg Kommunes Hjælpemiddelcenter og borgernes bopæl. Borgerne er primært bosiddende inden for kommunens bygrænse. Der kan dog forekomme enkelte transporter uden for kommunen. I disse tilfælde er der tale om adresser på Sjælland. I forbindelse med afleveringen skal nogle hjælpemidler monteres og samles, og der skal kunne gives en let instruktion i brugen af hjælpemidlet. Transporten omfatter både levering, afhentning og ombytning af hjælpemidlerne. Transporten skal foregå på hverdage i dagtimerne mellem 9:00 og 14:00. Der forventes at skulle gennemføres ca. 3.700 kørsler om året fordelt på henholdsvis transport af ”lette” hjæl pemidler, som almindeligvis kræver én person til transporten og ”tunge” hjælpemidler, som almindeligvis kræ ver to personer til transporten. Kommunen har erfaring for, at der ved kørsel af lette hjælpemidler gennemsnitligt kan gennemføres ca. 3-4 adressedrop pr. time. Ved kørsel af tunge hjælpemidler kan der gennemsnitligt gennemføres ca. 1-3 adres sedrop pr. time. Antallet af adressedrop afhænger blandt andet af hjælpemidlets karakter, eventuelle krav til montering og instruktion samt de geografiske afstande mellem adresserne. Oplysningerne er vejledende og baseret på kommunens hidtidige erfaringer. Kommunen forventer, at det årlige forbrug på kontrakten er ca. 0,8 mio. kr., eksklusive moms. Det forventede forbrug pr. år er alene udtryk for kommunens skøn, og er ikke bindende i aftaleperioden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et offentligt EU-udbud i henhold til afsnit II i lov nr. 1564 af 15. december 2015, ”Udbudsloven”, hvilket betyder, at enhver egnet tilbudsgiver har ret til at afgive tilbud. Den udbudte kontrakt træder i kraft den 1. januar 2027 og ophører uden varsel den 31. december 2029. End videre har kommunen en option på forlængelse i 2 x 12 måneder.

title: Puunkorjuu Länsi-Suomi 2027, Luontopalvelut
description: Puunkorjuu Länsi-Suomi 2027, Luontopalvelut Metsähallituksen Luontopalvelut pyytää tarjouksia puunkorjuusta ennallistamiskohteilla Kauhajoella, Isojoella ja Karviassa. Kaukaisin etäisyys hakkuukohteiden välillä on noin 50 km linnuntietä. Puunkorjuu sisältää talviaikana toteutettavia harvennus- ja ojalinjahakkuita. Korjuukohteet ovat pääsääntöisesti kantavuudeltaan heikkoja. Hakkuut on toteutettava 1.1.2027-31.3.2027 ja 1.1.2028-31.3.2028 aikana, mutta pakottavien sääolosuhteitten takia voidaan hakkuuaikaa jatkaa 1.1.2029-31.3.2029. Hakattava puumäärä on yhteensä noin 3100 m³ jotka jakautuvat noin 1900m3 talvelle 2027 (4 työkohdetta) ja 1200m3 (2 työkohdetta) talvelle 2028. Mikäli korjuuolosuhteet sallivat, niin talvella 2027 voidaan aloittaa jo tekemään vuoden 2028 kohteita (työkohteita yhteensä 6 kpl). Hehtaarikohtainen kertymä on keskimäärin 40 m³/ha. Hakkuukuvioilla, joissa on pelkkää ojalinjahakkuuta, taksa perustuu uudistushakkuuseen. Hakkuukuvioilla, joissa tehdään ojalinjahakkuun lisäksi myös harvennusta, käytetään kasvatushakkuun taksaa. Puunkorjuu ei sisällä hakkuutähteiden ajoa. Korjuut aloitetaan kaikilla työkohteilla vasta sitten, kun Metsähallitukselta on saatu lupa. Metsähallitus vastaa teiden aurauksista. Hankinta ja sen ehdot sekä vaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Tarjous pyydetään ilmoittamaan kertoimena Metsähallituksen taksataulukkoon perustuen. title: Professional Estate Management Services Framework
description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) operates across an estate comprising five buildings, four of which are located in Edinburgh (three being Category ‘A’ listed) and one in Dumfries. The historic and cultural significance of these assets requires the engagement of suppliers with demonstrable expertise in conservation led estates services and operational, specialist archival storage facilities and a clear understanding of the statutory, technical and professional requirements associated with working within protected and sensitive environments. Such services are critical to ensuring that NRS can continue to fulfil its role as custodian of Scotland’s records, while maintaining safe, compliant and functional accommodation for collections, staff and, where applicable, members of the public. NRS shares many common estate management challenges and requirements with other Scottish Government sponsored organisations, including Historic Environment Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Each partner organisation is responsible for the stewardship of nationally important, and in many cases listed or protected, operationally specialist buildings, landscapes and collections. These estates require a consistent, high quality and conservation focused approach to professional services, delivered by suppliers with proven experience of working within complex heritage environments. NRS has invited partner organisations to establish a joint Framework Agreement for professional estates services. The framework aims to secure access to a suitably skilled and diverse supply base with specialist technical and conservation expertise, reduce duplication of procurement activity, and provide a compliant, efficient and flexible mechanism through which participating organisations can call off services as required. This collaborative approach is intended to support value for money, improve service quality and resilience, and ensure that all organisations are able to discharge their custodial responsibilities effectively and sustainably over the life of the framework. Services that may be called off under the Framework include (but are not limited to): Multi disciplinary technical and design services (including architectural and engineering); Conservation led consultancy for listed and historic buildings; Support to in house estates and facilities teams, including specialist advice and surveys; Project and construction management; Health and safety, fire safety, asbestos surveys and management and water safety (including legionella) services; Planned maintenance planning, inspections, condition surveys and compliance support.

title: Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

title: Kultur|Kloster|Kyritz Los N020 Fliesen- und Plattenarbeiten
description: Bei der geplanten Baumaßnahme handelt es sich um den Umbau des Klausurflügel des ehemaligen Klosters (Bestandsgebäude) zum Museum. Zeitgleich wird daneben ein Neubau (Veranstaltungsgebäude mit Verbindern) errichtet. Das Baugrundstück liegt in Kyritz im Denkmalbereich "Altstadt Kyritz" und dem Bodendenkmal "Altstadt Kyritz". Im Zuge der Sanierung und Herrichtung des Veranstaltungsgebäudes werden Fliesen- und Plattenarbeiten in den Sanitärbereichen sowie in ausgewählten Sonderbereichen ausgeführt. Die Arbeiten umfassen die Lieferung und Verlegung keramischer Wand- und Bodenbeläge einschließlich aller erforderlichen Nebenleistungen, Untergrundvorbereitungen sowie Anschluss- und Abdichtungsarbeiten. In den Sanitärbereichen sind Wand- und Bodenflächen auf vorhandenen Estrichen, Stahlbetonwänden sowie Gipskartonuntergründen mit keramischen Belägen zu versehen. Vorgesehen ist die Ausführung von ca. 40 m2 Wandbelägen sowie ca. 45 m2 Bodenbelägen. Die Ausführung erfolgt einschließlich notwendiger Grundierungen, Abdichtungen im Spritzwasserbereich, Bewegungs- und Anschlussfugen sowie dauerelastischer Verfugungen. Darüber hinaus erfolgt im historischen Klausurflügel die fachgerechte Verlegung historischer Mettlacher Fliesen. Die Arbeiten in diesem Bereich sind unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der denkmalpflegerischen Anforderungen sowie unter Erhalt und behutsamer Einbindung der historischen Bausubstanz auszuführen.

title: Työnhaun ohjaus ja -neuvontapalvelu
description: Työnhaun ohjaus ja -neuvontapalvelu Työnhaun ohjaus ja neuvontapalvelu Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden asiakkaille. Työnhaun ohjaus ja neuvontapalvelu on ennakoivaa, työttömyyttä ehkäisevää ja nopeaa työllistymistä edistävää palvelua. Palvelu luokitellaan työnhakuvalmennukseksi. Palvelun tavoitteena on edistää ja nopeuttaa asiakkaiden työllistymistä sekä mahdollistaa asiakkaiden omatoiminen ja tehokas työnhaku. Tavoitteena on tarjota asiakkaille selkeät ja ajantasaiset ohjeet ja työkalut työnhakuprosessin tueksi, vahvistaa asiakkaiden työnhaun taitoja ja lisätä heidän ymmärrystään omasta osaamisestaan, työmarkkinoista sekä yrittäjyydestä. Palvelu on suunnattu Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden työnhakijoille, jotka tarvitsevat matalalla kynnyksellä apua työnhakuun, työllistymiseen sekä työelämässä tarvittaviin tietoteknisiin taitoihin tai työllistymisen esteiden tunnistamiseen. Palvelua toteutetaan ensisijaisesti verkossa ja palveluntuottajan järjestämissä tiloissa Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden alueella (Mikkeli, Kangasniemi, Juva, Hirvensalmi, Mäntyharju ja Puumala). Toteutuksen pääpaino on verkkowebinaareissa, joita voi itsenäisesti suorittaa ja joihin kuuluu yksilöohjausta. Lisäksi palvelu voi asiakkaan tarpeesta riippuen olla yksilöpainotteista valmennusta tai palvelua voidaan toteuttaa ryhmämuotoisena valmennuksena. Ryhmämuotoisen valmennuksen toteutus voi olla verkossa tai lähivalmennuksena. Myös eri teemaiset infotilaisuudet mahdollisia. Palvelun suunniteltu toteuttamisaika on 1.1.-31.12.2027. Lisäksi mahdollisuus kolmeen (3) yhden vuoden mittaiseen optioon seuraavasti: 1. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2028 2. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2029 3. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2030 Arvio palveluun ohjautuvasta asiakasmäärästä 500 asiakasta / vuosi. Arvio ei sido tilaajaa eikä aseta määräostovelvoitetta tilaajalle. Tarkempi kuvaus palvelusta on ilmaistu liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa.,

title: Kiinteistöjen nostolaitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalvelut
description: Kiinteistöjen nostolaitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalvelut Aalto-yliopistokiinteistöt Oy (Y-tunnus: 2842681-2), tilaajaorganisaatioidensa puolesta ja lukuun, pyytää tarjousta Aalto-yliopiston kiinteistöjen nostolaitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalveluista, jäljempänä Palvelu tai Palvelut, tässä tarjouspyynnössä asetettujen ehtojen ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankintaan osallistuvat tilaajaorganisaatiot (jäljempänä myös ”Tilaaja”) on lueteltu tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 3 ”Tilaajaorganisaatiot” (tarjouspyyntöhetken tilanne). Hankintaan osallistuvien kiinteistöjen määrät, laajuudet ja vastaavat voivat muuttua sopimuskaudella Tilaajan tarpeiden mukaisesti eikä Tilaajalla ole määräostovelvoitetta. Tarjoajien edellytetään huomioivan tämä tarjousta antaessaan. Tällä hetkellä nostolaitteita on vain Otaniemen kampuksella 17 eri rakennuksessa. Nostolaitteita on rakennuksissa tällä hetkellä 64 kpl. Hankinta sisältää eri nostolaitteiden vuosihuoltopalveluita, koekuormituksia ja määräaikaistarkastuksia, sekä laitteisiin tarvittavia korjauksia. Hankintasopimus tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa olevaksi palvelusopimukseksi. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan kohteesta on tarjouspyynnön liitteillä Cloudia Tarjouspalvelussa. Aalto-yliopistona toimiva Aalto-korkeakoulusäätiö sr (Y-tunnus 2228357-4) omistaa tällä hetkellä 20 erillistä kiinteistöosakeyhtiötä. Näissä kiinteistöosakeyhtiöissä on 39 rakennusta, joihin palvelua tilataan ja jotka sijaitsevat Otaniemen kampuksella Espoossa, yksi Töölössä Helsingissä ja yksi Kirkkonummella (Metsähovin radiotutkimusasema). Aalto-yliopiston rakennukset ovat kulttuurihistoriallisesti arvokkaita kiinteistöjä eri vuosikymmeniltä 1960- luvulta lähtien. Palvelun kohteena oleviin kiinteistöihin ja yliopiston kampuksiin voi tutustua virtuaalisesti alla olevien linkkien kautta osoitteissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rc7lhmaFYc0&t=1s https://virtualtour.aalto.fi/ Tarjoajille tarjotaan mahdollisuus tutustua paikan päällä kahden eri kohteen nostolaitteisiin tiistaina 6.10.2026 klo 12.00-14.00 tai perjantaina 9.10.2026 klo 9.00-11.00. Kierrokselle ilmoittaudutaan 2.10.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä sähköpostiosoitteeseen mia.mustonen@aalto.fi ja mikko.aho@aalto.fi. Molemmilla kierroksilla esitellään samat kohteet ja niiden nostolaitteet. Kohdekierroksella ei ole mahdollisuus esittää kysymyksiä, vaan kaikki kysymykset koskien palvelua esitetään tarjouspalveluportaalissa kirjallisesti 13.10.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä.,

title: Belgium – Compressors – Delivery of a Mobile Recompression Unit and the performance of the associated services
description: Delivery of a Mobile Recompression Unit and performance of the associated services for methane emission reduction during depressurisation activities on Fluxys’ gas network installations. The scope includes the design, manufacturing, supply, inspection and testing, shipping, commissioning, user training and start-up of a complete mobile recompression unit, including all equipment required for the compression process and associated maintenance and support services. The unit must be powered by a gas engine, installed in an outdoor enclosure, suitable for use with high-calorific gas and gas mixtures containing up to 10% hydrogen, and designed to recompress gas from pressure reducing lines, pig traps and isolated pipe sections for reinjection into the Fluxys network. The unit must comply with applicable Belgian legislation and European directives, minimise natural gas emissions, and be designed to provide the most economical CAPEX/OPEX solution. As an option, the Contractor shall also offer the integration of the unit on a flatbed truck of approximately 4.5 m x 2.1 m.

title: Ireland – Economic research services – Consultancy Services to prepare a Strategic Assessment and Preliminary Business Case in relation to the provision of Irish-language based early-years (Naíonra) facilities in Dún Gar
description: Naíonra Garbháin was established in 1981 as an early-immersion Irish-language based educational setting for pre-school children in Dún Garbhán and the surrounding areas. Dún Garbhán is a Baile Seirbhíse Gaeltachta (Gaeltacht Service Town). Naíonra Garbháin provides education and childcare services for people from the Gaeltacht who do not have access to housing in An Rinn or An Sean Phobal and who live in the surrounding area. Naíonra Garbháin is managed by a voluntary committee known as Croí na nÓg. As it is located immediately adjacent to the Irish-language based primary school, Scoil Gharbháin, progression from the Naíonra to the primary school is seamless and therefore the Naíonra is an important foundation and integral part of life on the Scoil Gharbháin campus. As the population of the town of Dún Garbháin, and in particular the area adjacent to the Naíonra, continues to grow, Croí na nÓg wishes to ensure that the facilities provided in the town of Dún Garbháin are sufficient to cater for the demand for Irish-language based education for pre-school children in the town. It also wishes to ensure that suitable facilities are available to cater for the demand for Irish-language based pre- and post-school services in the area. The latter is particularly important as a significant number of parents of primary school travel into Dún Garbháin on a daily basis for employment and are likely to avail of such services if they were available. Croí na nÓg have recently purchased lands immediately adjoining the Department of Education and Skills lands upon which Scoil Gharbháin is constructed and wish to ensure that the lands are utilised in the most efficient manner possible to meet the Irish-language based early education and pre/post school service demands of the area. Croí na nÓg wish to appoint a consultant to undertake a Strategic Assessment and Preliminary Business Case as envisaged in the Infrastructure Guidelines and the tender documents to improve the range of early-years educational and pre/post school services in the area.

title: Professional Estate Management Services Framework
description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) operates across an estate comprising five buildings, four of which are located in Edinburgh (three being Category âAâ listed) and one in Dumfries. The historic and cultural significance of these assets requires the engagement of suppliers with demonstrable expertise in conservation led estates services and operational, specialist archival storage facilities and a clear understanding of the statutory, technical and professional requirements associated with working within protected and sensitive environments. Such services are critical to ensuring that NRS can continue to fulfil its role as custodian of Scotlandâs records, while maintaining safe, compliant and functional accommodation for collections, staff and, where applicable, members of the public. NRS shares many common estate management challenges and requirements with other Scottish Government sponsored organisations, including Historic Environment Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Each partner organisation is responsible for the stewardship of nationally important, and in many cases listed or protected, operationally specialist buildings, landscapes and collections. These estates require a consistent, high quality and conservation focused approach to professional services, delivered by suppliers with proven experience of working within complex heritage environments. NRS has invited partner organisations to establish a joint Framework Agreement for professional estates services. The framework aims to secure access to a suitably skilled and diverse supply base with specialist technical and conservation expertise, reduce duplication of procurement activity, and provide a compliant, efficient and flexible mechanism through which participating organisations can call off services as required. This collaborative approach is intended to support value for money, improve service quality and resilience, and ensure that all organisations are able to discharge their custodial responsibilities effectively and sustainably over the life of the framework. Services that may be called off under the Framework include (but are not limited to): Multi disciplinary technical and design services (including architectural and engineering); Conservation led consultancy for listed and historic buildings; Support to in house estates and facilities teams, including specialist advice and surveys; Project and construction management; Health and safety, fire safety, asbestos surveys and management and water safety (including legionella) services; Planned maintenance planning, inspections, condition surveys and compliance support.

title: Professional Estate Management Services Framework
description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) operates across an estate comprising five buildings, four of which are located in Edinburgh (three being Category âAâ listed) and one in Dumfries. The historic and cultural significance of these assets requires the engagement of suppliers with demonstrable expertise in conservation led estates services and operational, specialist archival storage facilities and a clear understanding of the statutory, technical and professional requirements associated with working within protected and sensitive environments. Such services are critical to ensuring that NRS can continue to fulfil its role as custodian of Scotlandâs records, while maintaining safe, compliant and functional accommodation for collections, staff and, where applicable, members of the public. NRS shares many common estate management challenges and requirements with other Scottish Government sponsored organisations, including Historic Environment Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Each partner organisation is responsible for the stewardship of nationally important, and in many cases listed or protected, operationally specialist buildings, landscapes and collections. These estates require a consistent, high quality and conservation focused approach to professional services, delivered by suppliers with proven experience of working within complex heritage environments. NRS has invited partner organisations to establish a joint Framework Agreement for professional estates services. The framework aims to secure access to a suitably skilled and diverse supply base with specialist technical and conservation expertise, reduce duplication of procurement activity, and provide a compliant, efficient and flexible mechanism through which participating organisations can call off services as required. This collaborative approach is intended to support value for money, improve service quality and resilience, and ensure that all organisations are able to discharge their custodial responsibilities effectively and sustainably over the life of the framework. Services that may be called off under the Framework include (but are not limited to): Multi disciplinary technical and design services (including architectural and engineering); Conservation led consultancy for listed and historic buildings; Support to in house estates and facilities teams, including specialist advice and surveys; Project and construction management; Health and safety, fire safety, asbestos surveys and management and water safety (including legionella) services; Planned maintenance planning, inspections, condition surveys and compliance support.

title: Keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelun hankinta
description: Keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelun hankinta Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelun hankintaan. Hankinnan kohteena oleva palvelu sisältää Espoon kaupungin sekä sen konserniyhtiöiden (Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Sotekiinteistöt, Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö, Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Koulu- ja päiväkotitilat, Espoon Asunnot Oy, Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli, Kiinteistö Oy Opinmäen Kampus, Weegee Oy ja Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Lukio) omistamien tai hallinnoimien rakennusten, tilojen ja toimipisteiden keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelut. Rakennukset sijaitsevat Espoon kaupungin alueella. Tilaajalla on myös muita sopimuksia, joita käytetään kuljetusominaisuuksiltaan vaaralliseksi jätteeksi luokiteltuun SER-jätteeseen sekä muun tietoturvamateriaalin poistopalvelussa. Suurin osa mm. perustietotekniikasta poistetaan tämän sopimuksen kautta. Tarjoaja voi toteuttaa osan palvelusta alihankintana. Tietoturvamateriaalin käsittelyä ja siihen liittyviä palveluita ei saa toteuttaa alihankintana, henkilöstövuokrauksella eikä muiden yksiköiden tai voimavarayksiköiden henkilöstöä käyttämällä. Palvelu tulee tuottaa kokonaisuudessaan tarjoajan omalla henkilöstöllä ja omana toimintana. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Sopimus solmitaan yhden (1) Toimittajan kanssa. Lisäksi valitaan yksi (1) varatoimittaja. Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassaoleva. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on 717 000 (alv. 0 %). Eurot jakaantuvat hankintayksiköiden välillä seuraavasti: Espoon kaupunki 150 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Sotekiinteistöt 20 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Koulu- ja päiväkotitilat 50 000€ Espoon Asunnot Oy 447 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Opinmäen Kampus 10 000€ Weegee Oy 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Lukio 10 000€ Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita kirjallisesti, arvioitu hankinnan jakamista osiin sekä eri toteutusmalleja. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti. Hankinnan valmistelun yhteydessä toteutettiin markkinakartoitus potentiaalisista toimittajista tutustumalla hankinnan kohteena olevia palveluita tarjoavien toimittajien verkkosivuihin. Kartoituksessa tunnistettiin useita markkinoilla toimivia toimittajia. Hankintayksikkö lähestyi 8 toimittajaa lähettämällä 12.5.2026 tekniseen vuoropuheluun osan tarjouspyyntömateriaalista kommentoitavaksi sekä hankintaan liittyviä kysymyksiä vastattavaksi. Näistä kaksi yritystä vastasi kirjalliseen kommentointiin. Markkinavuoropuhelun tuloksia hyödynnettiin tarjouspyyntömateriaalin viimeistelyssä. Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut kirjallisen selvittelyn perusteella, että hankinnan kohteena oleville palveluille on olemassa toimivat markkinat ja että markkinoilla voi olla useita potentiaalisia toimittajia mutta kirjalliseen vuoropuheluun vastanneiden määrä jäi vähäiseksi. Kartoituksessa saatuja havaintoja hyödynnettiin hankinnan kohteen määrittelyssä, palvelutasovaatimusten arvioinnissa, hinnoittelurakenteen kehittämisessä sekä soveltuvuus- ja referenssivaatimusten tarkentamisessa. Hankinnan valmistelussa on huomioitu hankintalain 65 §:n mukaiset markkinakartoitusta koskevat periaatteet ja hankintayksikkö katsoo valmistelun tukevan kilpailun toteutumista. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut hankinnan jakamista osiin. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin ja SER-jätteen poistopalvelut muodostavat toiminnallisesti yhtenäisen palvelukokonaisuuden. Palveluiden tilaaminen, kohdehallinta, raportointi, laskutus ja Sopimuksen seuranta ovat samankaltaisia riippumatta poistettavasta jätejakeesta. Yhden toimittajan malli vähentää hallinnollista työtä, selkeyttää vastuunjakoa sekä tehostaa palvelun koordinointia Tilaajan laajassa ja hajautuneessa kohdeverkostossa. Hankintayksikkö katsoo, että jakamatta jättäminen on hankinnan luonne, toteutustapa ja tarkoituksenmukainen toteutus huomioon ottaen perusteltua.,

title: Germany – Fire-brigade and rescue services – Auswahlverfahren zu Stationierung und Betrieb eines Rettungswagens (RTW) am Standort Weiden
description: Der ZRF Oberpfalz-Nord beabsichtigt, eine Dienstleistungskonzession zum Betrieb eines weiteren RTW an dem Standort Weiden, voraussichtlich für den Zeitraum von 01.10.2027 bis 30.09.2037 zu vergeben. Mit dem bzw. der ausgewählten Bewerber / Bewerbergemeinschaft wird ein öffentlich-rechtlicher Vertrag geschlossen. Die vertragsgegenständliche Leistung des Konzessionsnehmers besteht in der Vorhaltung und dem Betrieb eines RTW sowie dem Transport von Notfallpatienten bzw. kranken, verletzten oder sonstigen hilfsbedürftigen Personen, die keine Notfallpatienten sind, mittels entsprechend geschulten Personals auf Weisung der Integrierten Leitstelle und grundsätzlich unabhängig von den Grenzen des Rettungsdienstbereichs. Die zu vergebenden Rettungsdienstleistungen sind Gegenstand einer Dienstleistungskonzession (vgl. Art. 13 Abs. 1 S. 1 BayRDG).

title: Metallbauarbeiten Fenster und Türen
description: Titel: Metallbauarbeiten Fenster und Türen Beschreibung: Die gesamte Baumaßnahme umfasst den Neubau eines Feuerwehrgebäudes auf dem Grundstück am Ferdinand-Porsche-Ring in Tarp, bestehend aus einer Fahrzeughalle mit 8 Stellplätzen, die von einem eingeschossigen Anbau mit angegliederter Küche von Süden und Westen „umklammert“ wird. Die hierfür neu herzustellenden Außenanlagen bestehen aus einer gebäudeumschließenden Zufahrtsstraße beginnend an der Zufahrt vom Ferdinand-Porsche-Ring zu den Besucher- und Alarmstellplätzen mit Anschluss an die südöstliche Übungsfläche und an den Hallenvorplatz nördlich der Fahrzeughalle Diese Ausschreibung umfasst die Metallbauarbeiten der Fenster und Türen Folgende Hauptleistungen sind u.a. im Rahmen dieser Ausschreibung zu erbringen: - Alu-Fensterelement, ca. 2 – 7m², 14 Stück - Alu-Fenster-Türelemente mit Einsatztüren, ca. 7 – 14 m², 4 Stück - Alu-Außentürelemente tlw. mit Oberlichtern, ca. 2 – 5 m², 9 Stück - Alu-Innentürelemente mit Oberlichtern, ca. 6 m², 2 Stück - T30 Alu-Innentürelemente, ca. 4 m², 1 Stück - T30 Stahlblechtüren, ca. 2 – 4m², 4 Stück - T0 Stahlblechtüren, ca. 2 – 3m², 8 Stück - Linear gehaltene Ganzglasvordächer, ca. 1,5m², 2 Stück

title: AI-POWERED OFFICIAL LANGUAGES LEARNING SOLUTION
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) is exploring tools to support employees in learning their second official language (English or French) in response to evolving operational and legislative requirements. The modernization of the Official Languages Act has reinforced the importance of maintaining and strengthening bilingual capacity across the organization to ensure compliance with the Agency's obligations to serve Canadians and support employees in the official language of their choice. Investing in effective and accessible second-language learning solutions will help the CRA maintain its bilingual capacity, support succession planning, and continue providing high-quality services in both official languages. As a result, the CRA is assessing the feasibility of implementing a scalable, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered language learning solution aligned with CRA corporate requirements and Government of Canada requirements. Responding to this Request for Information (RFI) is not a prerequisite to being eligible to bid on any subsequent solicitation. Any subsequent solicitation will be advertised on the Government Electronic Tendering Service commonly referred to as CanadaBuys. This RFI is not to be construed as a solicitation for tenders or proposals. No contract or other form of commitment will be entered into based on responses to this RFI. This RFI is not authorization by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) to undertake any work that would result in costs to the CRA. RFI Closing Date Responses must be received on or before October 22, 2026, no later than 14:00 EDT. All responses to this Request for Information must be directed in writing and submitted by email to: Contracting Authority: Charles Safarian E-mail: charles.safarian@cra-arc.gc.ca It is recommended that all electronic submissions contain a read receipt option to confirm that the email was received. Respondents are requested to provide a contact name, email address and telephone number when submitting their response. Please refer to the solicitation documents for further information and instructions regarding this opportunity.

title: Rental of equipment, machinery and tools
description: Description of Requirement: Canadian Heritage (PCH) is seeking the services of Offerors who can fulfil the rental of equipment, machinery and tools for such events. PCH Capital Experience Branch, as part of its mandate, produces major events which include Canada Day, Winterlude, Winter Lights Across Canada and other events annually. To support these productions and all its operations, PCH requires different types of equipment, machinery, and tools from time to time on an as-and-when-required basis. Duration of Contract: PCH may award up to two (2) Standing Offers for a period of award date to August 31, 2028 with the possibility of extending the Standing Offers for an additional two (2) one (1) year periods. Evaluation Process and Selection Methodology: All offers will be evaluated to determine if the Mandatory Technical Criteria detailed in Attachment 1 to Part 4 of the RFSO have been met. Offers that do not meet ALL Mandatory Technical Criteria will be declared non-responsive and their Offer will be given no further consideration. Basis of Selection – Mandatory Technical Criteria Only: An offer must comply with the requirements of the Request for Standing Offers and meet all mandatory technical evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. The responsive offer(s) with the lowest evaluated price will be recommended for issuance of a Standing Offer. Security Requirements: During the term of the Standing Offer, including the option year, should the Offeror’s personnel require access to sensitive work sites such as Parliament Hill, PCH will inform the Offeror and its personnel and PCH will grant or approve their SITE ACCESS CLEARANCE.

title: Forest Management at Valcartier and Farnham, Québec
description: Natural Resources Canada (NRCan), through the Canadian Forest Service—Laurentian Forestry Centre (CFS-LFC), has been entrusted by the Department of National Defense (DND) with the mandate to implement the integrated forest resource management plan for Valcartier Base (Base Va) and Farnham Base (Base Fa). Since 1994, various forest management and related activities have been carried out. To continue fulfilling this mandate, NRCan must carry out various forest management and related activities, including timber harvesting, silvicultural work, forest road maintenance, and other types of work in forest areas. This contract is based on a barter- principle. The initial Contract will end November 30, 2027. Canada reserves the option to extend the Contract for up to three (3) additional one (1) year period under the same terms and conditions. There will be an optional site visit on October 8, 2026.

title: Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7
description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT Canada has a requirement for the item detailed below: GSIN: N1375 – Demolition Materials UNSPSC: 46101600 –Ammunition Description: Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7 A requirement exists to resupply Canada with the Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7. The Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7 is required as the first step of an explosive shockwave in an explosive train when using a non-electric method of initiation. It is functioned by inserting an igniferous burning fuse into the open end and being crimped onto the burning fuse. When the flame from the burning fuse exits the end of the fuse, it ignites a primary explosive composition which in turn transfers a shockwave into the secondary explosive component in the Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7. The Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7 is primarily used in military applications for demolition purposes. Quantity: 3,000 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Dundurn, Dundurn, Saskatchewan on or before 01 November 2027. 3,500 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Angus, Angus, Ontario on or before 01 November 2027. 3,000 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Dundurn, Dundurn, Saskatchewan between 01 September 2028 and 30 November 2028. 3,500 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Angus, Angus, Ontario between 01 September 2028 and 30 November 2028. title: Bitterroot Front 10 Year G-Z IRSC
description: 9/17/2026- Amendment 001 Posted 8/3/2026- Replaces word versions of Attachements C04c_2a, C04d_3a and C04e_4a (Appendicies A-C) with PDFs. No other corrections. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Proposals are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 12363N26R4014 is issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) for the Bitterroot Front G-Z Long Term Integrated Resource Service Contract. The Bitterroot Front Project area spans roughly 145,000 acres across the Stevensville and Darby Ranger Districts, where dense, overstocked mixed?conifer stands and widespread tree mortality have increased susceptibility to insect outbreaks and extreme wildfire behavior. Following a decade of severe fires, the project aims to reduce wildfire risk to nearby communities and restore forest health through treatments such as thinning, harvesting, mechanical fuel reduction, and prescribed burning. These efforts focus on improving stand vigor, promoting fire?adapted species, reducing hazardous fuels, and enhancing safety and effectiveness for wildfire responders. A secondary objective of the long?term contract is to provide a consistent timber supply for local forest products industries, while contractors complete tasks including unit layout, timber cruising, road work, and timber removal as part of a broader strategy to increase the pace and scale of forest restoration. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 113310 and the small business size standard is 500 Employees This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Proposals are to be submitted via email to Mark Phillipp at mark.phillipp@usda.gov and Matt Daigle at matthew.daigle@usda.gov.

title: Collecte et transport des ordures ménagères
Stage 2 - Sidney Operations Centre Marine Fuel & Docks Replacement, Gulf Islands National Park Reserve
description: Parks Canada Agency has a requirement for a Contractor to replace the existing docks and marine fueling system at the Sidney Operations Centre (SOC), located at 2220 Harbour Road in Sidney, British Columbia, which serves as the primary Parks Canada Agency office and marine operations base for the Gulf Islands National Park Reserve. The work includes the removal, disposal, and replacement of the existing docks, pilings, and associated servicing systems. The Contractor will supply and install new aluminum-frame docks, pilings, water and electrical services, dock lighting, and a new fueling system consisting of a 5,000-litre fuel tank, fuel lines, and dispenser. All in-water works, including the removal of the existing docks and pilings and the installation of the new docks, must be completed within the lower-risk fisheries window between December 1, 2026, and February 15, 2027. Work occurring above the high-water line may be completed outside of this period. The Contractor will be required to implement the mitigation measures identified in Parks Canada Agency’s Basic Impact Assessment to minimize environmental risks and impacts associated with the project. TWO STAGE SELECTION PROCESS This posting is the Stage Two of a two-stage solicitation process: the first stage was to evaluate the qualifications of all interested suppliers. The second stage (Stage Two) is to invite the qualified suppliers to provide further qualifications and a financial bid on the project based on the specifications and drawings. Only qualified suppliers have been invited to bid. Potential and interested sub-contractors are invited to add their company’s name under the section “Partner with another business”.

title: Lead Hazardous Waste Removal for RCMP Indoor Firing Ranges (IFR), Alberta
description: This requirement is for the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. This requirement is open only to those Supply Arrangement Holders under EW479-162880 who can perform the services in the geographical location of Alberta. The requirement is intended to result in the award of one (1) contract. The following Supply Arrangement Holders have been invited to submit a proposal: Stericycle Aevitas Clean Harbors Canada Inc. and Affiliated Companies GFL Environmental Inc. KBL Environmental Ltd. Shield Specialize Emergency Services Inc. Veolia es Canada Services Industriels Inc. Miller Environmental SUMAS Environmental Services Quest Disposal & Recycling Environmental 360 Solutions Description of the Requirement: Lead Hazardous Waste Removal for RCMP Indoor Firing Ranges (IFR), Alberta The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) K Division, Real Property and Asset Management has a requirement for the cleaning, removal, packing, disposal and/or recycling of hazardous waste materials from four RCMP Indoor Firing ranges located in Edmonton, Red Deer, Edson and St. Paul, Alberta. Level of Security Requirement: Resource Minimum Security Level Required: RCMP Facility Access Level 2 with Escort (FA2) Applicable Trade Agreements: Canada Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Columbia Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement, Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement, Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement, Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement, Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), and World Trade Organization – Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-AGP) Proposed period of contract: The proposed period of contract shall be for one year from date of contract award inclusive, with the irrevocable option to extend the term of the Contract by up to three additional one year periods under the same conditions. Estimated Level of Effort: The estimated level of effort of the contract, per year and across all 4 locations, will be: 10 times per year : Using steel rod, check the depth of rubber pellets from surface of trap to rigid steps of the bullet trap structure or new lead buildup in the middle of trap and its both corners. Add rubber pellets into bullet trap to maintain 600mm (24 inches) depth. Refill the trap hopper with new rubber pellets. Rake rubber pellets to cover rubber membrane at the back of the trap with rubber pellets. Level rubber berm surface to make proper slope. 5 times per year: Fix, patch, and/or flip rubber curtains if applicable 4 times per year: Replacement of rubber curtains or panels if applicable 4 times per year: Lead mining of the bullet trap system 4 times per year: Deep cleaning of firing range, range walls 1.8m AFF, training gear (e.g., target holders, First Air kit, etc.), all horizontal surfaces, control and gun cleaning rooms, floors, HEPA vacuum inside filter sections of supply and exhaust units 5 times per year: Replacement of pre-filters for exhaust ventilation unit HEPA filters replacement must be coordinated with Project Authority and to be done every 5 years (for Edson, St. Paul, and Red Deer sites), and every 4 years (Edmonton HQ) The estimated level of effort provided is for bid evaluated price determination purposes only. Their inclusion does not represent a commitment by Canada that Canada’s future usage of the services described in the bid solicitation will be consistent with this data. title: Ireland – Social research services – Request for Tenders for the Provision of a Rapid Evidence Assessment in relation to reading for pleasure among children and young people in Ireland with a particular focus on boys and young men
description: The Department of Education and Youth is seeking research services from a suitably qualified contractor/s to conduct a rapid evidence review in relation to reading for pleasure among children and young people in Ireland, with a particular focus on boys and young men. For the purposes of this review, the terms children and young people and boys and young men refer to learners from the early learning and care (ELC) sector through primary and post-primary education. The review should therefore consider evidence relating to attitudes, engagement and participation in reading for pleasure across the continuum of educational provision, including key developmental and educational transition points.

For the purposes of this review, the terms children and young people and girls and young women refer to learners from the early learning and care (ELC) sector through primary and post-primary education. The review should therefore consider evidence relating to confidence in mathematics and numeracy, including learners' self-belief, mathematical self-efficacy, attitudes towards mathematics, and willingness to engage with mathematical learning across the continuum of educational provision, including key developmental and educational transition points.

description: FROM: AFLCMC/WISK Special Warfare Contracting Office 1895 Fifth Street Wright Patterson AFB, OH 45433-7200 SUBJECT: Request for Information (RFI) � Next Generation Operational Control System (NGOCS) NOTICE This Sources Sought Synopsis (SSS)/Request for Information (RFI) is issued for informational purposes and market research only; it does not constitute a solicitation. The Government will not reimburse any company or individual for any expenses associated with preparing/submitting information in response to this posting. The information provided may be used by the Government in developing its acquisition strategy, statement of work/statement of objectives, and/or performance specifications. BACKGROUND AND SCOPE The United States (US) Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance & Special Operations Forces (ISR & SOF) Directorate, Special Warfare (SW) Program Office (AFLCMC/WISN) is conducting market research to identify possible sources capable of providing the NGOCS. CAPABILITY GAP Operators currently lack a lightweight, ruggedized, modular body-worn power, data, and edge-compute architecture capable of providing distributed processing capacity beyond the End User Device (EUD) for concurrent high-demand tactical workloads. Fielded systems rely on aging architecture, proprietary cabling, and limited processing capabilities at the edge. Consequently, the EUD is forced to absorb the entirety of application processing, edge-server hosting, message routing, video data links, and peripheral management. During high-tempo combat operations, this overreliance creates latency, power depletion, and reliability bottlenecks that can jeopardize the mission. INSTRUCTION TO POTENTIAL RESPONDENTS Interested parties who desire to participate in this SSS/RFI are encouraged to submit responses that demonstrate they presently have the technology and qualifications to provide the system described above. Indicate whether the company is currently performing this type of work/whether the capability can be obtained under an existing Government contract. Provide the contract number(s) and Government points of contact accordingly. Indicate whether the company currently provides this type of work as a commercial solution. title: Coburn Gore LPOE Art in Architecture Project
description: Document Added & Updated: 0332CG-AIA- Coburn Gore AIA Questions & Answers V2 Dated 09 September 2026 The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) Art in Architecture Program commissions American artists (citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents or Permanent Workers of the United States) to create publicly scaled and permanently installed artworks for Federal buildings nationwide. GSA announces an opportunity for a Federal art commission in conjunction with the new construction of the Coburn Gore Land Port of Entry (LPOE) in Coburn, Maine. The new facility will strengthen supply chains, improve operational capabilities and facility infrastructure, spur economic growth, and bolster the country�s security. The project will provide a fully operational LPOE that coordinates with the tra?c ?ow and operations of the Canadian port of entry at Saint-Augustin-de-Woburn Quebec, Port of Entry. The project will provide a new port that allows Customs and Border Protection to more efficiently carry out its agency mission, their operations and interactions with the public. GSA allocates one-half of one percent (0.5%) of the estimated construction costs of new or modernized Federal facilities for art commissions. The art budget for this project is estimated to be between $275,000 to $400,000. One or more artists will be awarded a fixed-price contract for a commission. Artists who wish to be considered for this GSA art commission must submit application materials to GSA by the SAM Contract Opportunity�s Response Date. Artists may also elect to be considered for all future GSA art commissions by submitting application materials to GSA�s National Artist Registry (Registry). Instructions on how to submit application materials and join the Registry are available on the following Web site: https://www.gsa.gov/real-estate/design-and-construction/art-in-architecturefine-arts/art-in-architecture-program/art-in-architecture-national-artist-registry All artists who wish to be considered as candidates for a commission at the LPOE in Coburn Gore, ME must have their application materials submitted and received by GSA by 12:00 PM Eastern Time on 22 October 2026. Artists� submissions received after the deadline will not be considered for this project but will be eligible for consideration on future GSA commissions alongside the other artists on the Registry. Artists already on the Registry need not resubmit but may elect to update their information prior to the deadline. GSA evaluates artists based on the following criteria: the media, materials, content and style of the artist�s past work, along with the artist�s past performance and experience with commissions or projects similar to the one described in this synopsis. Shortlisted artists will be contacted and asked to submit additional information, including a statement that the artist can perform the work associated with the GSA commission within the identified budget. GSA will count the combined weight of all the selection criteria as significantly more important than price. At minimum, the scope of services for this commission will require collaboration with the lead designer selected for the land port of entry project; travel to the project site; development and presentation of preliminary and final concepts; fabrication of the artwork; participation in meetings and conservation reviews as necessary; delivery and installation of the artwork; professional documentation of, and detailed maintenance planning for the artwork at the project site. For informational purposes: Artists selected for the contract award must be Permanent Residents or Citizens of the United States of America. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of award. Instructions for creating an account and activating registration in SAM may be found at www.sam.gov. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to renew the registration in SAM on an annual basis for the duration of the project. In accordance with Executive Order (EO) 13934, agencies should prioritize the commission of works of art that portray historically significant Americans or events of American historical significance or illustrate the ideals upon which our Nation was founded. Inquiries concerning the project should be directed to the following email address: Molly.Lewis@gsa.gov and reference the synopsis number in the subject line.

title: FORT PIERCE HARBOR MAINTENANCE DREDGING, ST. LUCIE COUNTY, FLORIDA
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Project work includes maintenance dredging of Fort Pierce Harbor with excavated material being placed onto Fort Pierce Beach. Due to the extensive hardbottom areas located offshore of the fill area, offshore pipeline access to the beach site is prohibited. Offloading the beach fill will be done inside the South Jetty of Fort Pierce Inlet, as shown on the drawings. A staging area and beach access to the beach placement area are located at the end of Seaway Drive and near the south jetty pumpout location. Work also includes but is not limited to environmental and water quality monitoring, sea turtle trawl sweeping (hopper dredges only), screening, beach tilling, beach fill quality control, construction support, and vibration control and monitoring. Work will be divided into a base and two options. BIDS DUE: 22 October 2026 at 1:00 PM EDT. NAICS CODE: 237990, OTHER HEAVY CIVIL ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION. SMALL BUSINESS SIZE STANDARD: $37 million. TARGET PRICE RANGE: Between $5,000,000.00 and $10,000,000.00. PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: The Contractor shall be required to (a) commence work under this contract within SIXTY (60) calendar days after the date the Contractor receives the Notice to Proceed (NTP), (b) prosecute the work diligently, and (c) complete the entire work ready for use, and be off the beach, not later than 30 May 2027, with 30 June 2027 for the entire contract work. The time stated for completion shall include final cleanup of the premises. The completion date is based on the assumption that the successful offeror will receive the notice to proceed by 7 January 2027. The completion date will be extended by the number of calendar days after the above date that the Contractor receives the notice to proceed, except to the extent that the delay in issuance of the notice to proceed results from the failure of the Contractor to execute the contract and give the required performance and payment bonds within the time specified in the offer.

title: Design-Build Maintenance and Repair Army Reserve (MRAR) of Equipment Concentration Site (ECS), B-56767, at North Cavazos, TX
description: Request for Proposal (RFP), Solicitation No. W912QR25RA013 is issued for the repair of a failing Equipment Concentration Site (ECS), B-56767, at North Cavazos, TX. This project will repair and construct an addition to an existing ~26,000 square feet of the maintenance part of the Equipment Concentration Site, Maintenance Building 56767, that is in a failing condition, and has not undergone any major infrastructure or system repairs, only limited maintenance and repair work has occurred. The project includes repair of HVAC and Electrical systems, remove non-structural interior walls to right-size rooms and create open flexible workspace, restore inadequate and non-code compliant bathrooms, repair light fixtures with code compliant units, failed flooring, code compliant fire alarm and suppression system, repair electrical conduit distribution throughout the facility. Access for individuals with disabilities will be provided to include a code compliant entrance ramp. The restored facility will meet minimum DOD Antiterrorism standards. This project contains options. The contract duration is estimated at 913 calendar days from Contract Notice to Proceed (NTP). This award is Subject to the Availability of Funds (SAF). TYPE OF CONTRACT AND NAICS: This RFP will be for one (1) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this effort is 236220 � Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. TYPE OF SET-ASIDE: Total Small Business Set-Aside Procurement SELECTION PROCESS: This is a two-phase Design/Build procurement. The proposals will be evaluated using a Best-Value Tradeoff (BVTO) source selection process. The technical information contained in each Offeror's proposal will be reviewed, evaluated, and rated by the Government. Potential offerors are invited to submit their past performance, technical, and capability information as described in Section 00 22 16 and Section 00 22 18 of the Solicitation, for review and consideration by the Government. As described in Section 00 22 16 of the Solicitation, the selection process for Phase I will evaluate such factors as Past Performance (for both the Prime Contractor and A/E Designer of Record) and Technical Approach for Design/Build. Pro Forma Information such as bonding and financial capability will also be required to meet the minimum requirements of the solicitation. Following completion of the evaluation of Phase I, a target of five (5) of the most highly qualified offerors will be invited to participate in Phase II. The selected offerors for Phase II will be requested to submit additional information as will be described in Section 00 22 18 of the Solicitation, for review and evaluation by the Government. The selection process for Phase II will evaluate such factors as: Design Narrative, Management Plan, Schedule Narrative, and Price. The Standard Form (SF) 1442 will also be required. (NOTE: The evaluation factors for Phase II provided in Section 00 22 18 are issued as a DRAFT during Phase I and is subject to change with the Phase II amendment.) All evaluation factors, other than cost or price, are considered approximately equal to cost or price. DISCUSSIONS: The Government intends to award without discussions, but reserves the right to conduct discussion should it be deemed in the Government's best interest. CONSTRUCTION MAGNITUDE: The magnitude of this construction project is anticipated to be between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000, in accordance with DFARS 236.204. SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS: Paper copies of the solicitation and amendments will not be issued. Telephone, email, and fax requests for this solicitation, amendments, and attachments (plans and specifications) will not be honored. Project files are Portable Document Format (PDF) files and can be viewed, navigated, or printed using Adobe Acrobat Reader. To be able to download the solicitation for this project, contractors are required to register at the System for Award Management at https://sam.gov. Amendments, when issued, will be posted to the SAM.gov website for electronic downloading. This will be the only method of distributing amendments prior to closing; therefore, it is the Offerors� responsibility to check the websites periodically for any and all amendments to the solicitation. REGISTRATIONS: Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the following database: System for Award Management (SAM): Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the SAM database at http://www.sam.gov to be eligible for a Government contract award. If the Offeror is a Joint Venture (JV), the JV entity shall have valid SAM registration in the SAM database representing the JV as one business/firm/entity. If at the time of award an Offeror is not actively and successfully registered in the SAM database, the Government reserves the right to award to the next prospective Offeror. POINT-OF-CONTACT: The point-of-contact for this procurement is Bonny Dylewski, at bonny.c.dylewski@usace.army.mil PARTNERING WITH US: https://www.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/Partnering/ Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/Partnering/ and then clicking on: "View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here."

title: Winter Harbor Maintenance Dredging
description: DESCRIPTION THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS OR INVITATION FOR BIDS. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS, OR DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. The Norfolk District, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, is anticipating a future procurement for a firm-fixed-price construction contract for Maintenance Dredging of the Quinby Creek Federal Navigation Channel located in Accomack County, Virginia. DESCRIPTION OF WORK The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Norfolk District, is seeking qualified and experienced firms capable of performing maintenance dredging of the Quinby Creek Federal Navigation Channel in Accomack County, Virginia. The work consists of dredging approximately 200,000 cubic yards of maintenance material from the Federal channel. Dredging will be performed using a hydraulic cutterhead pipeline dredge, with dredged material hydraulically placed within the Government-designated overboard placement site in Upshur Bay. The maximum contract pay depth will be -7 feet mean lower low water (MLLW). In accordance with FAR 36.204(g), the estimated construction price range for this project is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The small business size standard applicable to Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities is $37,000,000. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources as a result of this Sources Sought Notice. CONSTRUCTION TIME The Contractor will be required to commence work within 15 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed (NTP). The anticipated construction period of performance is approximately 180 calendar days from issuance of the NTP. SURVEY OF THE DREDGING INDUSTRY The following confidential survey questionnaire is designed to apprise the Corps of prospective dredging contractors' project execution capabilities. Please provide responses to the following questions. All questions pertain to the Quinby Creek Maintenance Dredging project in Accomack County, Virginia. Please provide the company's name, address, point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Would your firm be interested in bidding on this requirement if a solicitation is issued? If no, please briefly explain why. Has your firm performed dredging projects similar in nature, complexity, and magnitude to this project within the past five years? Has your firm managed dredged material placement sites with inflows similar in magnitude to this project within the past five years? If so, describe the project(s), identify for whom the work was performed, provide the dollar value of the project(s), and identify a point of contact and telephone number as a reference for the relevant experience. Would your firm bid on this project as a sole contractor, prime contractor with subcontractor(s), or as a joint venture? Is there a dollar limit on the size of contract your firm would bid? If so, what is that limit? What is the largest dredging contract, in dollars, on which your firm was the prime contractor? What is your firm's bonding capacity per contract? What is your firm's total aggregate bonding capacity? Identify your firm's business size and all applicable socioeconomic categories, including Large Business, Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, and Women-Owned Small Business. Is your firm familiar with the safety and health requirements of EM 385-1-1? Please include only a concise narrative addressing the requested information. Additional information may not be reviewed. This Sources Sought Notice should not be construed as an obligation by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Norfolk District, to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it create any right to reimbursement for costs incurred in responding to this notice. No solicitation is currently available. The Government will use the information received to assist in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy. All prospective contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at SAM.gov prior to contract award. Responses to this Sources Sought Notice must be submitted no later than 22 October 2026 via email to LTC George Jackson at george.jackson@usace.army.mil and Luke D. Hedlund at luke.d.hedlund@usace.army.mil. Any future solicitation for this requirement will be issued through SAM.gov.

title: Craney Island Rehandling Basin Dredging
description: DESCRIPTION OF WORK The work consists of maintenance dredging, hydraulic placement of dredged material, and debris removal at the Craney Island Rehandling Basin. The project is located on the southeast side of the Craney Island Dredged Material Management Area (CIDMMA), adjacent to the Norfolk Harbor Channel in Portsmouth, Virginia. Maintenance dredging and debris removal will occur in the following areas: � North Access Channel to a depth of -18 feet MLLW � South Access Channel to a depth of -18 feet MLLW � Debris Channel to a depth of -9 feet MLLW � Rehandling Basin to a depth of -20 feet MLLW Optional bid items will include increased dredging depth within the Rehandling Basin to -23 feet MLLW. The estimated quantity for the base work is approximately 260,000 cubic yards of dredged material, including allowable overdepth and anticipated accretion. Debris, including wire, rope, steel, and wood, may be encountered during dredging operations and shall be managed and removed by the Contractor. All dredged material shall be hydraulically transported by pipeline and placed at the Government-furnished upland placement site within the Craney Island Dredged Material Management Area. CONSTRUCTION DURATION The Contractor shall commence performance within 15 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed (NTP) and complete all work within 180 calendar days. There are no known dredging time-of-year restrictions associated with this project. SURVEY OF THE DREDGING INDUSTRY Interested firms are requested to provide the following information: Company name, address, point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Indicate whether your firm would be interested in submitting a bid for this requirement. If not, briefly explain why. Describe your firm's experience performing dredging projects of similar size, scope, and complexity. Include project descriptions, customers, contract values, dredging quantities, and dredge plant utilized. Identify the type of dredge plant and supporting equipment your firm owns and/or operates that would be suitable for this requirement. Describe your firm's experience managing upland dredged material placement sites with inflow volumes similar to this project. Indicate whether your firm would compete as a prime contractor, as part of a joint venture, or with subcontractors. Provide your firm's bonding capacity, both single-project and aggregate. Identify your firm's business size and all applicable socioeconomic categories, including Large Business, Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), and Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB). SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Responses shall be limited to a concise narrative addressing the information requested above. Additional information may not be reviewed. This notice is for market research and planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting a response. The Government will use the information received to assist in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy, including consideration of potential small business participation. Kirtsey, Contracting Officer tiffany.n.kirtsey@usace.army.mil Responses are due no later than 22 October 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time. title: Survival Vest Improvement System
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. This notice does not constitute a commitment by the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary, and the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. The Naval Air Warfare Center, Aircraft Division (NAWCAD), Patuxent River, Maryland is requesting information and conducting market research to identify and determine if there are potential sources to manufacture and deliver a Survival Vest Improvement System (SVSI). SVSI is comprised of a new survival vest, VIPER, and a low-profile Life Preserver Unit, Serpent. VIPER is a NAVAIR owned design that incorporates a Small Business Innovative Research (SBIR) armor release system designed by Bunker Supply. The LPU Technical Data Package is owned by Switlik Parachute Company. As part of its market research, NAVAIR - PMA202 is issuing this Sources Sought to determine if there exist an adequate number of qualified interested contractors capable of providing the requirement. The Government may use the responses to this Sources Sought for information and planning purposes. This Sources Sought is only for the purpose of identifying potential sources as part of NAVAIR � PMA202 market research. No Request For Quote (RFQ) exists; therefore, do not request a copy of the RFQ. Responses to this Sources Sought are not quotes on which the NAVAIR � PMA202 can issue any contract. This Sources Sought is issued for information and planning purposes only and does not itself constitute an RFP or RFQ. The Government does not intend to award a contract vehicle based only on responses to this Sources Sought. All information received in response to this Sources Sought marked "Proprietary" will be protected and handled accordingly. Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary or competition sensitive information contained in their response. Responses to the Sources Sought will not be returned. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this Sources Sought. NAVAIR � PMA202 will not pay for information received in response to this Sources Sought. Do not submit pricing information in response to this Sources Sought. Interested sources shall provide a response detailing their capability to manufacture and deliver SVSI. Respondents should provide a brief description of their experience manufacturing similar equipment, including any relevant past performance data (if available). Additionally, respondents should include their experience with manufacturing Critical Safety Items. Respondents should also describe their capacity; production quantities are anticipated between 260 and 1543 annually with the potential to go higher . The Government anticipates a solicitation for a five-year Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) in Fiscal Year 2027. The Government will provide a TDP with the solicitation in FY27 for the vest. The government does not possess or own data rights necessary to distribute for the LPU. Any interested parties MUST copy all parties listed below: Greg Tollefsen, Procurement Contracting Officer gregory.e.tollefsen.civ@us.navy.mil Amy Wescott, Contract Specialist amy.l.wescott.civ@us.navy.mil No telephonic responses WILL NOT be accepted.
